title: Status shows as a color-coded badge whose label text is always present
refs: SV-8660 (WIP spec v22 2026-08-18 Story 4 S4-R6 + Story 10 S10-R8 — S4-R6 CLOSES the five status labels verbatim ("Estimate" ... "Complete") and the label-not-colour rule; so the closed list IS the requirement)
preconds:
1. You are signed in to the ShopView App on a desktop browser.
  2. The report shows work orders in several statuses (Estimate, Approved, In progress, Review, Complete).
steps:
1. Read the Status column across rows in each tab.
  2. Compare each badge's color against the application's standard status colors used elsewhere.
expected:
1. Status is shown as a badge using the status's label: "Estimate", "Approved", "In progress", "Review", or "Complete".
2. The badge is color-coded per the application's standard status colors.
3. The label text is always present, so color is never the sole signal of the status.

---
This is the expected behaviour as per epic SV-8582, read on 17 August 2026, and the Work In Progress report specification version 28 (S4-R6, S10-R8), read on 18 August 2026.
Last checked against build v3.8-bd246fd on 8/18/2026.
